description: Representations the project uses or names, one entry per representation of one model. The model block is the engine's study identity (short id, Hugging Face id, pinned commit); it is not a statement about what a hosted service loads. A null means this registry holds no value and its pointer is listed in the entry's not_recorded. links_enabled is true only for verified_exact. On 2026-11-10 no real entry is verified_exact, so no real link is built. Representation types are different objects and are never interchangeable.

verification_meaning.verified_exact: The Neuronpedia ids were read in a primary source and the hosted checkpoint revision is recorded and equals the study revision. The only status that permits a link.
verification_meaning.alias_unverified_checkpoint: Another id is reported for the same checkpoint. No record of the checkpoint revision behind that id was read. An alias alone verifies nothing.
verification_meaning.hosted_identity_unknown: The engine uses these hosted ids and responses have landed. The service reports no model, dictionary or instrument revision, so what answered is not identified.
verification_meaning.unverified: The representation is named in a source that was read. Its own manifest or page was not read.

evidence.states: CALIBRATED_FEATURE_SOURCES holds exactly one pair: (gemma-2-2b, gemmascope-transcoder-16k).

entries.notes: The one calibrated feature source. The ids are the ones the hosted route answers to. Which model commit the service loads and which transcoder weights commit the set holds are not recorded, so the status is hosted_identity_unknown and links are off. README.md:51 links the Gemma Scope transcoders at google/gemma-scope-2b-pt-transcoders; no record ties the hosted set to a file or commit of that repository. Labels: the two features sampled on 2026-10-09 carried two explanations each (oai_token-act-pair and np_max-act, both from gemini-2.0-flash; docs/cross-model.md:66-71). A sample of two does not establish the explainer for the set, so explanation_type and explanation_model are not recorded. Layer numbering is inferred to be zero-based and is not recorded. No feature page pattern was read in a page or in source code.

entries.notes: A workspace readout is a per-layer reading of the residual stream over the vocabulary. It has no component index and no label source. No instrument revision is recorded, so the status is hosted_identity_unknown. Layer numbers come from the response's meta.layers_by_type, or from list position when that is absent (scripts/jlens_readout.py:164-170); the index base is not recorded. The only lens page pattern the engine holds puts the prompt in a query string (scripts/export_jlens_transport.py:151-156). This registry records no pattern for it and scripts/experiments/neuronpedia.py builds no such link.

entries.notes: An alias only. The two ids are reported to name the same base checkpoint. No record read today states which Hugging Face commit Neuronpedia serves under qwen3.5-2b-pt or which commit its ICA components were fitted on, so equality with the engine pin is unverified. The ICA source-set id, source ids, layers, component-id form and label source on Neuronpedia are unknown. To move this entry to verified_exact: read the Neuronpedia model record and the ICA release's manifest, record the checkpoint commit in hosted_checkpoint_revision, and confirm it equals the engine pin.

entries.notes: The basis manifest icalens.json on Hugging Face was not read: huggingface.co is blocked from development containers. The basis revision, the tensor hashes, the layer list and the model revision the basis was fitted on are therefore not recorded. No Neuronpedia mapping is known for this basis. The paper's reconstruction run loaded the model at the engine's pinned commit. That is a statement about one evaluation run. It is not the fit revision stored in the basis, and the run does not pin which basis revision it loaded.
